experiment.name: jepa_v6_hard_disjoint_action_run_001
experiment.description: Hard-disjoint action-anchored JEPA with multi-mode predictor and distance-margin loss.
experiment.notes:
Pretrain budget is 50 chunks by default so multiple architectural
variants can be screened quickly before committing to a full 200-chunk
run on the best two or three.

sections.title: Linear Head: Validation Next-Move (top-1/3/5, loss)
sections.description: Frozen JEPA context encoder + trainable linear head trained on all valid next-move positions. Validation on held-out chunks.

sections.title: Linear Head: Legal-Move Evaluation (top-k legal hit rate, probability mass)
sections.description: Replays games on CPU with the rule engine; scores the trained linear-head probability distribution per token against the legal-move set at that position.

sections.title: Board State Probes (linear): Absolute (B/W/empty) and Relative (mine/yours/empty) per layer
sections.description: Linear probes fitted on frozen activations at each layer (0 = embeddings, 1..N = post-block residual stream). Two label spaces, accuracy per layer.

sections.title: Linear Head: Legal-Move Evaluation (top-k legal hit rate, probability mass)
sections.description: Replays games on CPU with the rule engine; scores the trained linear-head probability distribution per token against the legal-move set at that position.

sections.title: Board State Probes (linear): Absolute (B/W/empty) and Relative (mine/yours/empty) per layer
sections.description: Linear probes fitted on frozen activations at each layer (0 = embeddings, 1..N = post-block residual stream). Two label spaces, accuracy per layer.

sections.title: Board State Probes (linear): Absolute (B/W/empty) and Relative (mine/yours/empty) per layer
sections.description: Linear probes fitted on frozen activations at each layer (0 = embeddings, 1..N = post-block residual stream). Two label spaces, accuracy per layer.

sections.title: MLP Next-Move Head: Validation (top-1/3/5, loss)
sections.description: Frozen JEPA context encoder + small MLP next-move head trained over all valid positions. Same validation protocol as the linear head.

metrics.layer_evaluated: all token positions from final encoder layer

sections.title: MLP Board State Probe: Absolute B/W/empty per layer (non-linear probe)
sections.description: Non-linear (MLP) probe fitted on the same activation cache as the linear board probe.

sections.title: Linear Legal-Mask Probe: per-square legality from context activations (linear probe)
sections.description: Per-layer linear probe predicting the 64-dim binary legal-move mask from context activations.

sections.title: MLP Legal-Mask Probe: per-square legality from context activations (non-linear probe)
sections.description: Per-layer non-linear (MLP) probe predicting the 64-dim binary legal-move mask from context activations.

sections.title: MLP Next-Move Head: Legal-Move Evaluation (top-k legal hit rate, probability mass)
sections.description: Same legal-move evaluation as the linear head, but using the MLP next-move head outputs.

sections.title: Predictor-Space Next-Move Head (linear): Validation (top-1/3/5, loss)
sections.description: Frozen JEPA context+predictor features feeding a linear next-move head. Validation top-k and loss on held-out chunks.

sections.title: Predictor-Space Next-Move Head (mlp): Validation (top-1/3/5, loss)
sections.description: Frozen JEPA context+predictor features feeding a mlp next-move head. Validation top-k and loss on held-out chunks.

sections.title: Predictor-Space Board State Probe (linear): Absolute (B/W/empty) and Relative (mine/yours/empty) per layer
sections.description: Per-layer linear probe over the JEPA predictor representation, predicting board occupancy (absolute and relative).

sections.title: Predictor-Space Board State Probe (mlp): Absolute (B/W/empty) and Relative (mine/yours/empty) per layer
sections.description: Per-layer mlp probe over the JEPA predictor representation, predicting board occupancy (absolute and relative).
